qa.q: What is the Weekly Agent Battle?
qa.a: A weekly contest in snakepit, the trading app next to the game. Pick an AI agent (Turtle plays it safe, Snake is balanced, Wild swings big) and one lucky coin from the week's board of five. The agent trades for you all week and the best % return on Sunday evening wins. Right now every week is a practice week: live prices, practice SOL, free to join, and nothing is paid in or out.
alts: How does the agent battle work?
What is the AI trading contest?
What is the battle in the Pit?
How do I join the battle?
qa.k: battle agent contest weekly turtle snake wild boost leaderboard

qa.q: What does BOOST do in the battle?
qa.a: Once a day you can press BOOST on your battle card. For the next 24 hours your agent bets one step bigger on each trade, up to the safety limit. When to press it is your call: it is the one move you make during the week. Everything else locks when the week starts.
alts: Can I change my agent during the week?
What can I change after the battle starts?

qa.q: Does the battle use real money?
qa.a: Not yet. Battle weeks are practice weeks: the prices are real but the SOL is practice SOL, entry is free and nobody is paid in or out. Real SOL weeks only open once the money can be held safely on-chain and the rules have had a legal review. It is not financial advice: trading can lose money.
alts: Can I win real SOL in the battle?
Do I pay to join the battle?
qa.k: battle real money practice free paper prize

qa.a: Open memecapes.com in a browser on your phone or computer and press Play free. There is nothing to download and no wallet is needed. Tap the ground to walk, tap a tree, rock, fishing spot or monster to use it, and follow the starter guide card in the top left for your first few minutes.
alts: Where do I play the game?
How do I get into the game?

qa.a: Yes. The game is free to play in your browser. You do not need an account to try it and you never need crypto to play. The only things that cost money are optional: the shop, skins, the streamer pass and the launchpad.
alts: Do I have to pay to play?

qa.q: Does MemeCapes work on my phone?
qa.a: Yes. The game is built phone first and runs in the phone browser (Chrome, Safari, Samsung Internet and others). Hold the phone upright, tap to walk, drag to turn the camera and pinch to zoom. Older or very cheap phones can feel slow in big towns: turn shadows off in the settings.
alts: Does it work on a tablet?
qa.k: mobile iphone android tablet ipad app

qa.q: Do I need to download anything?
qa.a: No. MemeCapes runs entirely in your browser. There is no installer, no app store download and no launcher. Bookmark memecapes.com and you are set.
alts: Is there an app to install?
Can I get it on Steam?

qa.q: How do I move my character?
qa.a: Tap or click the ground where you want to go and your character walks there. Tap something in the world (a tree, a rock, a fishing spot, a monster, a person) to use it. On a computer you can also click and drag to turn the camera.

qa.q: How do I turn the camera?
qa.a: Drag on the screen (or click and drag with the mouse) to turn the camera around your character. Use pinch, the mouse wheel or the + and - buttons to zoom. Massive buildings and the castle turn see-through when they block the view; everything else stays, so turn the camera yourself.
alts: How do I rotate the view?
How do I zoom in and out?
The camera is stuck behind a building

qa.a: The small card in the top left of the game walks you through your first few minutes: walk, meet Froggo, chop a tree, light a fire, catch shrimps, cook them, mine some ore, defeat a weak meme and visit a bank. A gold arrow points to the nearest thing you need. Finishing it pays Meme Coins and a small XP lamp. The x hides it and the small ? brings it back.
alts: What is the card in the corner?
How do I get the tutorial back?
I closed the guide by accident

qa.a: Follow the starter guide: chop a tree, light a fire, fish and cook a few shrimps, mine some copper, then fight a level 1 Wojak Wanderer outside the castle. Then talk to Froggo by the castle gate for your first quest, and walk down the road to Wow Landing, the first town.
alts: What do I do when I start?

qa.q: Where do I start in the game?
qa.a: Every new adventurer wakes up in the courtyard of Castle Gigachad with a wiped wallet, a bronze sword, an axe, a pickaxe, a tinderbox, a net and some bread. Froggo waits by the gate, the fields outside have level 1 memes, and the road leads to Wow Landing.

qa.q: What gear do I start with?
qa.a: A bronze sword, a bronze axe, a bronze pickaxe, a tinderbox, a shrimp net and some bread. That is enough to fight, chop, mine, make fires and fish on day one.
alts: What items do new players get?

qa.q: Can I change how my character looks?
qa.a: Yes. On the start screen you pick skin, hair, shirt, pants, boots and whether your adventurer is male or female. Capes and skins you earn or buy later change the look too. Looks never change your stats.
alts: How do I customise my character?
Can I pick a female character?
qa.k: appearance look hair skin outfit female male

qa.a: You. In the story, Normies are the only people in MemeCapes who are not made of Clout, which means the Rugpuller cannot edit or control you. That is why Froggo recruits you.
alts: Why am I called a Normie?

qa.q: How do I zoom in or out?
qa.a: Pinch on a phone, use the mouse wheel on a computer, or press the + and - buttons on the screen.
alts: The game is too zoomed in

qa.q: Can I play on a computer?
qa.a: Yes. Any modern browser on Windows, Mac, Linux or ChromeOS works. Click to walk, click and drag to turn the camera, and use the mouse wheel to zoom.
alts: Can I play on a Mac?
Does it run on a Chromebook?
qa.k: pc mac windows laptop chromebook desktop

qa.a: Any current browser works: Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge, Samsung Internet and Brave. If something looks wrong, update the browser first; very old browsers cannot run the 3D world.
qa.k: browser chrome safari firefox edge brave

qa.q: How long does it take to load?
qa.a: The first visit downloads the world and its models, so give it a few seconds on a good connection and a little longer on mobile data. Later visits are faster because the browser keeps the files.
alts: Why is the game loading slowly?

qa.a: Yes: The Great Rug. The internet became a world, the Seven Originals built the towns and wove their Clout into seven capes, and one of them, the Dev, drained the Liquidity and became the Rugpuller. You are the Normie he cannot edit. Read the full story on the Story page.

The first memes: Shibe, Froggo, Wojak, Chad, Stonks Guy, Moon and the Dev. Each wove their Clout into an OG Cape. The Dev corrupted his and became the Rugpuller; the other six capes are scattered across the world and the story chapters are about getting them back.
In the story, Clout is the magic of being seen: the power that memes are made of. The Seven Originals wove theirs into capes, and those capes kept the world's Liquidity flowing until the Rug.
alts: What does Clout mean in the story?

qa.a: Not to try the game: you can play as a guest and the game saves in your browser. To play online with other people, keep your progress across devices, chat and trade, create a free account on the start screen.
alts: Can I play without signing up?
Can I play as a guest?

qa.q: How do I create an account?
qa.a: On the start screen choose Create Account, pick a username (3 to 12 letters, numbers or underscores, no spaces) and a password of at least 8 characters that you do not use anywhere else. That is all: no email, no wallet, no phone number.
qa.k: create register sign up username password

qa.a: Usernames are 3 to 12 characters long and can only use letters, numbers and underscores. No spaces, no symbols. Your username is shown to other players above your head and in chat.
alts: Can I use spaces in my name?
How long can a username be?

qa.a: Not at the moment. Pick a name you are happy to wear, because it is shown above your head and in chat. If you really need a different name, start a new account.
alts: How do I rename my character?

qa.a: At least 8 characters. Use a password you do not use on any other site, ideally from a password manager. MemeCapes never emails you, so nobody from MemeCapes will ever ask for it.
alts: How long must my password be?

qa.q: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
qa.a: There is no automatic reset yet, because accounts have no email or phone attached (we keep what we know about you to a minimum). Keep your password somewhere safe. If you are locked out, message @Mrsnakebaby on X from the account you play with and we will see what can be done, but we cannot promise recovery.
alts: How do I reset my password?
qa.k: forgot reset recover password lost locked out

qa.a: Not from inside the game yet. If your password may have leaked, stop using it elsewhere and message @Mrsnakebaby on X so we can help secure the account.
alts: How do I update my password?

qa.q: Why does it say "Could not reach the game server"?
qa.a: The game could not open its connection to the server. The usual causes: you are on plain http instead of https (the site now sends you to https automatically; reload once), a very strict network or VPN is blocking the connection, or the server is being restarted. Wait a minute and try again. You can always choose Play offline in the meantime; an offline game saves in your browser.
alts: Login says the server is unreachable
Could not reach the game server
The game will not let me log in
qa.np: the "could not reach the game server" message
qa.k: server unreachable connect login error offline

qa.a: If the start screen shows an online player count, the server is up. If it says Offline or Reconnecting, wait a minute and reload. Short restarts happen when we ship updates; you can play offline meanwhile.
alts: How do I check if the server is online?

qa.a: With an account, on the game server, so you can log in from any device. As a guest or offline, only in your browser's local storage on that device: clearing site data, private browsing or switching devices can lose it.
alts: Is my save in the cloud?
Will I lose progress if I clear my browser?

qa.q: Can I play on another device with the same account?
qa.a: Yes. Log in with your username and password on any phone or computer and your character, bag, bank and skills come with you. Only one device can be logged in at a time.
alts: Can I switch between phone and PC?
Can I use my account on two devices?
qa.vp: use my account on another device

qa.q: Can I move my guest progress into an account?
qa.a: When you create an account on the device where you played as a guest, the game offers to carry your local progress over. After that the account save is the one that counts.
alts: Will I lose my guest save if I register?
Transfer offline progress to my account

qa.a: Type /logout in the chat box, or close the tab. Logging out on a shared device keeps your account safe.

qa.q: Can I have more than one account?
qa.a: You can make more than one, but please play fair: using several accounts to cheat, farm or get around a ban is against the rules and can get all of them suspended.
alts: Can I make a second account?

qa.a: Yes. Message @Mrsnakebaby on X from the account you play with and ask for the account to be deleted. Deleting is final: the character, items and Meme Coins are gone.
alts: How do I remove my account?

qa.q: How old do I have to be?
qa.a: You must be 18 or older to use MemeCapes. The game has crypto features, so it is not for children, and we do not knowingly collect anything from anyone under 18.

qa.q: What is the age gate when I open the site?
qa.a: The first time you visit, the site asks you to confirm you are 18 or older and that you agree to the Terms and the Privacy Policy. It remembers your answer in your browser and asks again only when the terms change.
alts: Why does the site ask my age?

qa.a: The game logs you out when the same account logs in somewhere else, when the connection drops for too long, or when the server restarts for an update. Just log in again; your progress is saved on the server.
alts: Why did the game kick me?

qa.q: Someone else is using my account. What do I do?
qa.a: Log in and the other session is kicked. Then stop using that password anywhere, and message @Mrsnakebaby on X so we can help lock things down. Never share your password, even with someone who says they are from MemeCapes.

qa.q: Why does my login say the name is locked?
qa.a: Too many wrong passwords in a row lock a name for a short while to stop password guessing. Wait a bit and try again carefully.
No. Accounts have no email, and MemeCapes never emails or messages you first. Any email or DM that claims to be from MemeCapes is fake.
alts: I got an email from MemeCapes

qa.a: Yes. With an account you see other players walking the world, chat with them, and trade with them. The start screen shows how many real players are online right now.
Open the chat box at the bottom of the screen, type and press enter. Messages are short (80 characters) and appear above your head and in the chat log. Be kind: the rules apply in chat.
alts: How do I talk to other players?

qa.a: /who lists the players online, /trade name sends a trade request, /ignore name hides a player, /unignore name shows them again, /report name reason reports a player, and /logout logs you out.
qa.k: commands slash who trade ignore report logout

qa.q: How do I see who is online?
qa.a: Type /who in the chat. The start screen also shows the number of real players online.
Type /ignore followed by their name. You will no longer see their chat or trade requests. /unignore turns it back.
alts: How do I mute a player?

qa.q: How do I report a player?
qa.a: Type /report, their name and a short reason, for example /report name scamming. Reports go to the team. For anything urgent or with screenshots, message @Mrsnakebaby on X.

qa.q: Are there bots in the game?
qa.a: Yes. To keep the world lively while it grows, MemeCapes has a few dozen bots: computer-controlled characters that look and act like players. They walk around, chat, chop trees, fish and mine. They never trade, never use the Stock Market and never take your kills or resources, and there are fewer of them as more real people play. Bots are never counted as players in anything we post.
alts: Why does nobody answer my trade request?

qa.q: How do I tell a bot from a real player?
qa.a: You usually cannot, and that is on purpose. The clue is behaviour: bots never accept trades and never use the Stock Market. The online count on the start screen and /who only count real people.
alts: Can I trade with a bot?

qa.q: What happens when I lose connection?
qa.a: The game says it is reconnecting and tries again on its own. Your last save is on the server. If a trade was open it closes safely: nothing is swapped unless both sides had already pressed accept.
Yes. Choose Play offline (or Guest) on the start screen. The world, skills, quests and monsters all work; you just will not see other players, chat or trade, and the save lives in that browser only.
alts: Does the game work without internet?

qa.q: Why is the online player count so low?
qa.a: Because it counts real people only, never bots. The game is new and grows every week.

qa.q: Can I message a player privately?
qa.a: Not yet. Chat is public to the people around you. Private messages and friends lists are on the list for later.

qa.q: Why can't I see my friend?
qa.a: You both need to be logged in to accounts (not guests or offline) and standing near each other in the world: the game shows people within sight of you, not the whole map. Check the start screen says Online, then meet at a landmark like Froggo at the castle gate.
alts: My friend and I cannot see each other
How do I find my friend in game?

qa.a: Yes. Reports are read, and players who harass, scam or spam can be muted or banned. Links in chat are limited to keep scams out.
alts: Can I post links in chat?

qa.a: The glowing ring in every town. Step in and it teleports you to any town you have already walked into once. The Grand Tour quest unlocks all eight.
alts: What is the ring in town?

qa.a: Fifteen: Attack, Strength, Defence, Health, Prayer, Woodcutting, Mining, Fishing, Cooking, Smithing, Kindling, Agility, Bounty, Farming and Construction. Each goes to level 100, and each has a cape at 100.
alts: How many skills are in the game?

qa.q: How do I level up a skill?
qa.a: Use it. Every chop, catch, cook, smelt, kill or plant gives XP in its skill, and levels come from XP. XP lamps (from quests, random events and the starter guide) give a chunk of XP in a skill of your choice.
Level 100 in every skill. At 100 the Cape merchant sells you that skill's cape; two skills at 100 and your capes come with a gold trim.
Tap a tree with an axe in your bag. Higher Woodcutting levels chop faster and better axes help too. Logs feed fires (Kindling), become planks at the sawmill (Construction) and sell to shops.
Tap the bubbling spots in the water with a net in your bag. Shrimps come first; better spots and fish come with levels. Froggo's Pond has fishing spots right off the boardwalks.
Carry raw food and tap a fire you lit or a cooking range in any town. Low levels burn some of the food; burnt ones still count as practice.
Tap a copper or tin rock with a pickaxe in your bag. Rocks empty for a moment and come back. Copper Hills near Diamond Hands has plenty of rocks.
qa.k: mining ore rock pickaxe copper tin

qa.a: Smelt ore into bars at a forge (every town has one), then smith bars into tools and weapons. Bronze needs copper and tin.
alts: How do I make a bronze bar?

qa.a: Kindling is the fire skill. Tap logs in your bag and choose Light (you need the tinderbox). Fires cook food, and the Frozen Shibe skilling boss is all about keeping a brazier burning.
alts: How do I light a fire?

qa.a: Agility comes from running and moving around the world and from the Grand Tour quest. Higher Agility helps you get around and counts toward your combat level.
Bury bones from kills for Prayer XP. Prayers help in combat and use Prayer points; pray at an altar to restore them.
Buy seeds at the general store and plant them in an allotment patch (Wow Landing has them). Come back later to harvest potatoes, onions, cabbages and tomatoes.
Turn logs into planks at the sawmill in the Castle Gigachad courtyard (a small fee per plank), then build with them. More to build comes with the updates.

qa.q: How does the Bounty skill work?
qa.a: Bounty is the slayer skill. Bounty Boss Bonkwell in Wow Landing gives you a bounty: kill a set number of one meme monster. Each kill pays Bounty XP equal to its hitpoints plus Bounty points. Do not like a bounty? Spend 25 points to skip it.
alts: How do I skip a bounty?

qa.q: How does the Health skill work?
qa.a: Health levels raise your hitpoints. It trains alongside your fighting skills, and food heals you back up to the maximum.
alts: How do I get more hitpoints?

qa.a: Items you rub for a lump of XP: the Wish lamp, Big wish lamp and the Genie lamp from the Lamp Genie random event, which lets you pick the skill.
alts: How do I use a genie lamp?

qa.a: A single number that sums up your fighting skills (Attack, Strength, Defence, Health, with a little from Prayer and Agility). It shows on your name tag.
alts: How is combat level worked out?

qa.q: What are the Capes of Accomplishment?
qa.a: The skill capes: one per skill, sold by the Cape merchant once you reach level 100 in that skill, for a million Meme Coins each. Two skills at 100 and they come trimmed in gold.
alts: How do I get a skill cape?

qa.a: In the game menu. They rank real players by skill and total level; bots are never on them.

qa.q: What are town tasks and achievement diaries?
qa.a: Each town has a diary of tasks (chop here, fish there, beat this, visit that). Finishing a diary earns a diary cape. Wow Landing has the easiest one, a good first goal.
alts: How do I get a diary cape?

qa.a: A collection log of every drop you have found, with the rare ones marked. Filling it earns a Collection cape.
alts: How do I track rare drops?

qa.a: Classic tick-based combat: tap a monster to attack it and your character trades hits until one of you drops. Your weapon, Attack, Strength and Defence levels decide how often and how hard you hit. Eat food from your bag when your health gets low.
alts: How do I attack a monster?

qa.a: You keep your three most valuable items. The rest go into a gravestone where you died, and you have 15 minutes to walk back and collect them. Items dropped in the Wildlands are lost. You respawn at the castle.
alts: Do I lose my items when I die?
qa.k: die death gravestone lose items respawn

qa.a: Eat food from your bag: bread heals 5, cooked shrimps 3, party cake 8, potions 10. Health also comes back slowly on its own.
alts: How do I get my health back?

qa.a: Aggressive memes like Bonk, Fartcoin, Book of Meme, Floki, Popcat, Nutty, Mog, Rage Goblins and Doomscrollers attack when you come near. Peaceful ones like the Wojak Wanderer, Slerf, the Ghost of Rugmoon, Vibe Dog and Gigachad only fight back. The NPCs page lists every monster with its style.
alts: Why does that monster keep attacking me?

qa.q: Why are monster levels so strange?
qa.a: Meme-coin monsters take their level from the real market cap of the coin they parody, so Shibe is level 50 and Slerf is level 1. Story monsters have fixed levels.
The level 1 Wojak Wanderer in the fields outside Castle Gigachad. He only fights back, has 5 hitpoints, and drops Meme Coins, bread and meme scraps.
alts: Which monster should I fight first?

qa.a: In his forest. Bonk is a level 25 boss with 28 hitpoints who attacks on sight and drops the Bonk bat as a rare. His little cousins, the Bonk Hounds, are level 5 and needed for The Bonk Problem quest.

A level 75 boss with 175 hitpoints waiting in his lair in the far north-west. The Ratio Lord quest (after The Bonk Problem and Wojak Blues) sends you there; he drops Ratio shards and, rarely, Ratio Knight armour and the Ratio shield.
alts: How do I beat the Ratio Lord?
Where is the Ratio Lord lair?

qa.a: A skilling boss on the frozen peak north of the castle. Nobody fights him with swords: you chop frost roots and burn them in the brazier (Kindling level 10) until the ice gives up, and he pays in supply crates full of loot.
alts: How do I fight the Frozen Shibe?

qa.a: Some weapons have a special attack that uses your special energy for a bigger hit or an effect. The bar refills over time.
alts: How do I use a special attack?

qa.a: Prayers boost you in a fight while they drain Prayer points. Restore points at an altar, and raise your Prayer level by burying bones.
The dangerous land out past Rugpull Ridge where Algorithm Cultists roam. Items you drop by dying there are lost for good, so go in light.

Most monsters have a rare drop with the odds shown on the NPCs page: the Bonk bat from Bonk, the Viking helmet from Floki, Mog shades from Mog Coin, the Wojak mask, the Rage mask, the Jester hat, Chad armour and more. The loot log keeps track of what you have found.
Yes. Bonk Hounds and Golden Hounds have a 1 in 100 chance to drop a pup that follows you around. Pets are for show only.
alts: How do I get a pet?

qa.a: Every 25 to 45 minutes someone may pop in: Rich Wojak leaves Meme Coins, Snack Shibe brings free food and the Lamp Genie grants an XP lamp. Each has a 1 in 200 chance of leaving a rare cape.
qa.k: random event rich wojak snack shibe genie

qa.a: A level 20 thief who steals Meme Coins straight out of your bag mid-fight. Kill him fast, and bank your coins before you go looking for him.
alts: Why did I lose coins in a fight?

qa.a: A combat challenge near Moon Landing. Beat it and you earn the Meme cape.
alts: How do I get the Meme cape?

qa.a: Low Attack level against a high-defence monster means lots of misses. Train on weaker memes first, use the best sword you can smith or find, and keep your health up with food.
alts: Why do I do so little damage?

qa.a: No. There is no player-versus-player fighting in the world. Meme Wars, a team minigame, is planned for a later update.
The boss of the Feels Bad, Man quest: he and his Spam Bots attack the castle gate and you hold it. Nothing to do with the computer-controlled characters that walk the world.
qa.k: bot captain spam bots gate quest

qa.a: Thirty-five slots. Meme Coins do not take a slot. Bank the rest at any bank to make room.
alts: How many items can I carry?

qa.a: Every town has a bank and the castle has one too. Tap the banker to deposit and withdraw items; the bank has tabs and a search box, shows a picture of everything, and keeps your items safe even when you die. Bank booths in the field work the same.
alts: Is the bank shared between towns?

qa.q: How do I examine an item?
qa.a: Tap and hold (or right-click) an item in your bag and choose Examine. Every item has a line of its own, and the Items page on the site lists them all.
alts: How do I see item info?

qa.q: How do I drop an item?
qa.a: Tap and hold the item in your bag and choose Drop. Dropped items vanish after a while, so bank anything you want to keep.

qa.q: How do I equip a weapon or armour?
qa.a: Tap the item in your bag and choose Wear or Wield. Weapons, helmets, body armour, shields, necklaces and capes all have a slot and show on your character in 3D.
alts: How do I wield a sword?

qa.a: A one-use tablet sold in general stores. Break it to jump straight to Wow Landing, Stonks City or Froggo's Pond.
Bits of old memes dropped by many monsters. They are collectables and sell to shops; keep an eye on the quests and the loot log for uses.
alts: What do I do with meme scraps?

qa.a: A treasure trail. Read the clue scroll, follow it across the world, and dig or search where it says. Finishing one can pay a Treasure cape or a Gilded meme hat.
qa.k: meme hunt clue scroll treasure trail

qa.a: A locked box of loot. Open it from your bag and hope for treasure. Supply crates from the Frozen Shibe work the same way.
alts: How do I open a strongbox?

qa.q: Where do I get a better axe or pickaxe?
qa.a: Smith one from iron at a forge, buy one at the general store, or earn one: Wojak Blues rewards an iron axe.
alts: How do I get an iron axe?

qa.a: The general store in every town sells food, tools, seeds and teleport tablets, and buys most things from you. Bread, cooked fish and party cake are the easy heals.
alts: What does the general store sell?
Where is the shop in town?
qa.k: general store shop buy food sell

qa.a: Weapons and armour do. Capes are cosmetic except the Burn and Rug Pit capes, which come later. Skins never change stats.
Dust from a shooting star. Shops buy them. Look up when a star falls.

qa.q: Can I lose items from my bank?
qa.a: No. The bank keeps everything safe through deaths and disconnects. Only what is in your bag can be lost when you die.

qa.q: How do I get more Meme Coins?
qa.a: Drops from monsters, quest rewards, selling logs, fish, ore and bars to the general store or the Stock Market, Rich Wojak visits, and the starter guide. Bank them so a Clout Bandit cannot pick your pocket.

Eight meme towns plus Castle Gigachad: Wow Landing, Froggo's Pond, Stonks City, Diamond Hands, Rugpull Ridge, HODL Heights, Moon Landing and Chad Falls. Every town has a bank, a general store, a forge and a cooking range, a well, stalls, lamps and a Meme Telly ring.
Wow Landing, down the road from the castle. Thatched cottages, a windmill, the church, allotments, Bounty Boss Bonkwell by the forge and the easiest achievement diary in the game.

A swamp town east of the castle built on stilts over the water, with fish shacks, docks, lily pads, a shrine and fishing spots right off the boardwalks. The wild Froggo roams nearby and is not polite.
The money town in the middle of the map where every road crosses: gothic row houses, the old Exchange and the clock tower. It rains there more than it should.
Blue-and-white manor houses in the north-west, home of the knights who never sell. Copper Hills and its mines are a short walk away.
The south-west frontier: boarded-up houses, the manor, the crypt, dead trees, and the Wildlands and the Ratio Lord's lair beyond.
High in the north under the Copium Mountains: log cabins, the lodge, the monastery, the bell tower and snow.
The south-east, where the moon memes landed: habitat pods, the dome, the antenna, the lunar lander and craters. The Meme Caves open nearby.
Red-roofed villas on the east coast by the sea, with the colosseum and the baths. The last stop on the Grand Tour.

qa.q: How do I travel between towns?
qa.a: Walk the roads (signposts at every town entrance point the way), break a teleport tablet, or step into a Meme Telly ring to jump to any town you have visited before.
alts: How do I get to another town?

qa.a: Yes, the World map in the game menu shows the towns, roads and your position. A better minimap with fog of war and waypoints is on the roadmap.
alts: How do I open the map?

qa.a: A quest from Froggo: walk to all eight towns in order, easiest first. Each town you reach joins the Meme Telly, and the reward is Agility XP, Meme Coins and a Big wish lamp.

qa.a: Open the Wardrobe, tap the skin to see the big picture, try it on, then choose Buy. Skins are paid from your wallet and belong to your account from then on.

qa.a: No. Skins belong to your account and cannot be traded, sold or given away. That keeps holder perks in-game and stops farming.

qa.a: Tap a skin in the Wardrobe and choose Try it on: the camera circles your character wearing it for 30 seconds, then everything goes back to normal.

qa.a: Cape skins change the look of a cape you wear. Try it on shows the cape even if you are not wearing one yet.

qa.q: How do I trade with another player?
qa.a: Type /trade and their name, or tap them and choose Trade. Both of you put items in the window, check the big pictures, names and values, then press Accept on both screens. Watch for the change warnings: if the other side changes anything, the accepts reset.

qa.q: Why did my trade request go nowhere?
qa.a: The other player may be busy, offline, ignoring requests, or a bot: bots never trade. Try someone else or ask in chat.
alts: Trade request sent but nothing happened

qa.q: Can I get scammed in a trade?
qa.a: The trade window is built to make it hard: both players see the same items with pictures and values, a change by either side cancels the accepts, and nothing moves until both press Accept twice. Still, read the window every time and never trade for anything promised outside the window.

Anyone can launch a Solana coin from memecapes.com. You choose the trading fee and how much of it you keep, bots that buy in the first seconds pay a sniper fee, you can split your share with up to 10 wallets, and the coin's liquidity is locked for good when it graduates. Your wallet signs everything; MemeCapes never holds your keys or your money.
alts: How do I launch a coin?
Can I create a token on MemeCapes?

qa.q: What does it cost to launch a coin?
qa.a: The network fees of creating the coin on Solana, paid from your wallet, plus the trading fee you choose for your coin. The Launch page shows every fee before you sign.
Buyers in the first seconds after a launch pay a higher fee that fades quickly. It makes sniping with bots expensive and leaves more of the early supply for real people.
When a coin fills its bonding curve it graduates to a normal market, and its liquidity is locked for good: nobody, not the creator and not MemeCapes, can pull it.

qa.q: Who owns the coins launched here?
qa.a: The people who launch them. MemeCapes receives a part of each coin's trading fee, shown on the coin's page before anyone trades, and nothing else. We can hide a coin from our pages if it breaks the rules, but we cannot change or remove it from the blockchain.

qa.q: Is launching or buying coins risky?
qa.a: Yes. Most new coins lose most of their value, prices can go to zero, and blockchain transactions cannot be reversed. Nothing on the launchpad is investment advice. Only put in what you are happy to lose.
alts: Can I lose money on the launchpad?

qa.q: How do I split fees with my team?
qa.a: When you set up the coin you can name up to 10 wallets and the share each one gets. It is written into the coin and shown on its page.
Every coin page shows who bought in the launch block and the next few, and whether they still hold, so buyers can spot bundling and sniping before they trade.
alts: How do I spot a bundled launch?

qa.q: Can I launch from inside the game?
qa.a: The Launchpad clerk in Gigachad Town and Stonks City opens the Launch page for you in a new tab.

qa.q: Why did my launch transaction fail?
qa.a: Usually not enough SOL for the network fees, a wallet that rejected the signature, or a congested network. Check the wallet, top up a little SOL and try again; nothing is created until the transaction confirms.

qa.q: Does the launchpad work on devnet or testnet?
qa.a: The public launchpad is on Solana mainnet. Test networks are for the team.

qa.q: Is the game server guarded against attacks?
qa.a: Yes. An always-on guard inside the servers rate-limits floods, stops password guessing and blocks abusive addresses, and it can pause sign-ups and uploads on its own if something looks wrong. We do not publish the details, for obvious reasons.

qa.a: Message @Mrsnakebaby on X, or use the contact details at the bottom of the site. Include what the notice is about and how to reach you.

Six story updates, three minigames, three new skills and the cape that ties it together: The Great Rug, Maps and Capes, Stonks and Bonds, The Jeet Invasion, The Copium Mines, The Burn and The Final Rug. The Roadmap page has the detail.
